name: Kanojo no Seiheki -Touchou x Mousou-
original_name: カノジョの性癖-盗聴×妄想-
source: The protagonist, who works at a company in Hebizuka city, started dating a colleague called Koimori Moeka. After having sex with her at a hotel, he notices her phone was in recording mode and Moeka reacts erratically when asked about it. The next day, he goes to a store that sells listening devices to try and understand why Moeka behaved the way she did. He learns that she has a fetish for sex sounds and sometimes gets aroused listening to them. When he meets her again, he apologizes for his behavior and tells that he loves her and wants to accept everything about her, even this fetish. Moeka had been struggling with the idea of suppressing her fetish but the protagonist's acceptance helps her come to terms with it.
translation: 主人公在蛇塚市的一家公司工作，开始与同事古伊万里萌香交往。两人在酒店做爱后，他注意到她的手机开着录音模式，问起此事时，萌香却反应失常。第二天，为了弄清她为何如此，主人公走进一家出售窃听设备的商店，了解到她对性爱声响有特殊癖好，有时会因听见这些声音而兴奋。再次见面时，他为自己的反应道歉，告诉萌香，自己爱她，也愿意接受她的一切，包括这个癖好。萌香原本一直为是否该压抑这种癖好而挣扎，而主人公的接纳，帮助她逐渐接受了自己。
